project.name: Macro Watch
project.goal: Every week, tell me what the macro picture implies for what I actually hold — not a newsletter, a consequence. Read what the market already prices first (forward curves, breakevens, swap-implied policy paths, the shape of the curve), say what it is pricing, then say where we differ and why. Every view carries a horizon, the mechanism that has to play out, the observable that would falsify it, and a probability you are willing to be scored on. Maintain a scorecard of past calls and what happened, updated whenever a call resolves, and report the hit rate honestly. Cite official series with their release and vintage, and check that conclusions survive the revision history. When the honest answer is that something is unknowable at useful precision, that is the finding.
